unlisted_practices: Using LLMs only at authoring time to draft dialogue, with human-editable finite state machine output so all patient-facing content is validated and no LLM hallucinations reach patients
No-code authoring interface for clinicians to edit LLM-drafted health education dialogue

screen.reason: Empirical usability and feasibility evaluation of an LLM-assisted dialogue authoring tool designed to prevent hallucinations by constraining outputs into human-reviewable finite-state machines.

primary.practice: human-in-the-loop dialogue editing and finite state machine constraint
